transport_model: canonical bounded Channel<T> coordinator; no second waiter list

required_invariants.name: bounded_capacity
required_invariants.rule: admitted item count never exceeds configured capacity

required_invariants.name: immediate_full_nonretaining
required_invariants.rule: try_push on full returns Full and retains no pending writer

required_invariants.name: one_shot_ticket
required_invariants.rule: one ticket authorizes at most one push attempt

required_invariants.name: cancel_before_admit_no_ghost
required_invariants.rule: cancellation that wins before write commit removes the writer and its payload never appears

required_invariants.name: cancel_after_admit_nonrevocable
required_invariants.rule: successful admission cannot be revoked by later cancellation

required_invariants.name: pending_writer_fifo
required_invariants.rule: live pending writers commit in deterministic registration order as capacity becomes available

required_invariants.name: cancelled_older_progress
required_invariants.rule: cancelling an older pending writer cannot prevent a later live writer from advancing

required_invariants.name: close_settles_pending
required_invariants.rule: actual item-channel close settles all uncommitted pending writers without admitting their payloads

required_invariants.name: close_drains_fifo
required_invariants.rule: already-admitted items remain FIFO-readable after close

required_invariants.name: closed_empty_terminal
required_invariants.rule: closed plus drained is terminal and does not manufacture data

required_invariants.name: bounded_waiter_budget
required_invariants.rule: pending writer retention is bounded and exhaustion fails closed

required_invariants.name: local_capability_confinement
required_invariants.rule: queue/ticket channel capabilities cannot cross actor message boundaries

required_invariants.name: generation_invalidation
required_invariants.rule: unclaimed pre-close tickets cannot authorize post-close admission

required_invariants.name: no_busy_polling
required_invariants.rule: pending admission suspends through canonical scheduler/channel registration rather than polling or a library waiter loop

required_invariants.name: rejected_push_returns_payload_ownership
required_invariants.rule: every non-admitted push returns the exact original payload; only successful admission permanently transfers ownership into the queue

pending_push: ticket cancellation competes with the uncommitted channel write
Channel.close terminally settles an uncommitted pending write
write commit permanently admits the payload
arbitration.close_linearization: close the actual item channel under the canonical channel coordinator; never emulate closure with a consumable token
arbitration.receive_linearization: already-committed FIFO data drains before the channel reports closed+empty terminal state

evidence_rule: Each backend must execute independently. Source support, runtime substrate tests, and guest execution are separate gates. Zero-step CI is NOT_EXECUTED.
